title: A piece — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a piece's `piece.yaml` (DEC-001 points 3 and 7, DEC-002 point 5, DEC-003 point 8, DEC-004 point 10): what the piece is, its notations, its state, its modes, what it produces, the losses it accepts, the place of its current copy, and its lock. A person writes it; a render rewrites only its lock, keeping every other byte. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:piece`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

top.description: The piece's top component, as a use.

brand.description: The brand the piece is drawn in, by its library's name.

notations.description: The notations its content names concepts from, each by its library's name (DEC-004 point 10).

languages.description: The languages of the piece's content, the first its source language; each has its `content.<language>.yaml`.

audience.description: Who the piece is for, in words.

shown.description: Where the piece is shown, in words.

explains.description: Whether the piece explains, rather than only shows.

exports.description: The formats a numbered export makes (DEC-006 point 7): `svg`, a file for each page and combination, `svg-modes`, a switching file for each page that holds the modes a reader's signal names and follows the reader as an image (DEC-018 point 1), `pdf`, a file that holds every page, and `html`, a page file that holds every page and the modes a reader's signal names (DEC-023 point 1); may be empty. `svg` and `svg-modes` write files of one name, so a piece names one of them (DEC-018 point 2).

state.description: The piece's stage of life, which says who moves its lock (DEC-003 point 8): a draft, whose lock each render moves; a final piece, whose lock never moves; or a published piece, whose lock moves only through a change a person reviews.

modes.description: The modes the piece is drawn in, by axis; an axis it names none of is drawn in its default.

pinned.description: Whether a draft's lock is pinned: it moves only when a person moves it. It is read of a draft alone.

produced.description: Each picture a producer makes for the piece (DEC-006 points 1 to 4): the producer, the roles it reads, by input, and the pixel size of each variant.

inputs.description: Each input of the producer names a role, by its token path, never a raw value.

copy-place.description: The folder a published piece's current copy lies in, in place of the piece's folder (DEC-006 point 7, DEC-017 point 8): a plain path, such as the place the documentation's rules put a page's produced images. An export refuses a place the rules refuse.

lock.description: The version of each library the piece uses; a render writes it.
